instruction: Can you add Files (nautilus) to the favorite applications?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding Files (nautilus) to favorite apps. Initial state has [thunderbird, vim, chrome], final state should have [thunderbird, vim, chrome, nautilus]. Uses existing check_gnome_favorite_apps metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts GNOME favorite apps using 'gsettings get org.gnome.shell favorite-apps'
Metric correctly parses the gsettings output format and compares with expected apps
Expected value is semantically correct: includes initial 3 apps + org.gnome.Nautilus.desktop
Length check ensures exactly 4 apps (prevents user from adding extra unrelated apps)
Set comparison correctly handles order-independence of apps in the favorites list
Evaluator fully covers the instruction requirement: verify that Files (nautilus) was added to favorites
Logic will correctly distinguish between success (nautilus added, others preserved) and failure (nautilus missing, apps removed, or extra apps added)
